## 1. Agreement — Software Development and IP Assignment Agreement

**Parties:** (1) Fernhill Wellness Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai **[CIN/Address]** (*Fernhill/Client*) (2) Orbitmade Studio LLP, Bengaluru **[LLPIN/Address]** (*Orbitmade/Developer*).

### 1. Definitions
**Deliverables:** app (iOS/Android), source/object code, documentation, designs, and all work product in SOW Exhibit-A, excluding Pre-Existing Materials and approved Open Source. **Pre-Existing Materials:** Orbitmade Core UI/networking libraries listed in Exhibit-B existing before this Agreement. **Open Source:** third-party code listed in Exhibit-C. **Personal Data:** as under DPDP Act, 2023. **SOW:** Exhibit-A scope, specs, timeline, Acceptance Criteria.

### 2. Services and Statement of Work
2.1 Orbitmade shall develop, deliver and implement Deliverables per SOW with professional skill, on time. Time is of essence for Store launch by **30 June 2026**.
2.2 Changes only by signed Change Order (scope, fee, timeline impact). No GPL/copyleft code without Fernhill prior written consent.

### 3. Fees and Milestones
3.1 Fixed fee **₹2,00,00,000 + GST**, payable: M1 Discovery ₹20L; M2 Design ₹40L; M3 Beta ₹72L; M4 Store launch ₹64L **[Confirm: totals ₹1.96cr — allocate balance ₹4L to M4?]**.
3.2 Against GST invoice after Milestone Acceptance, within **[30 days]**. No payment waives Acceptance/warranty. Expenses included unless SOW states otherwise.

### 4. Acceptance
4.1 On delivery, Fernhill has **[10] Business Days** to test against Acceptance Criteria. Failure to reject = deemed acceptance, except latent defects and warranty breaches.
4.2 Fernhill may reject with defect list; Orbitmade shall cure and re-deliver within **[10 days]**, up to **[2]** rounds. Uncured material failure: Fernhill may withhold milestone, require re-performance, or terminate for cause and get refund for rejected Milestone.

### 5. Intellectual Property
5.1 **Assignment:** To satisfy Copyright Act ss.17,19, Orbitmade hereby assigns to Fernhill, upon creation and on payment **[for that Milestone]**, all rights worldwide in Deliverables (including all copyright, source code, designs, patents/ designs applied for): work identified in Exhibit-A; rights assigned: all exclusive rights including reproduction, adaptation, publication, communication, rental, assignment and to make derivative works; royalty: nil separate, included in Fees; duration: perpetual; territory: worldwide. Ss.19(5)-19(6) defaults expressly excluded; s.19(4) lapse disapplied by agreement.
5.2 Orbitmade shall execute further deeds, waive enforceability of moral rights to extent permitted, and procure same from personnel/subcontractors. “Work for hire” alone confers no title from a contractor.
5.3 **Pre-Existing Materials:** Orbitmade retains title to Exhibit-B Core. Grants Fernhill perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable, sub-licensable licence to use, modify and distribute as embedded in Deliverables, including source **[escrow/hand-over terms: [●]]**.
5.4 **Open Source:** Only Exhibit-C MIT/Apache code permitted; Orbitmade complies with licences and gives notices/attribution. **SleepWave (GPL-3.0) in mobile client NOT approved** — **[Fernhill to decide: replace with permissive alternative or approve isolation/architecture at own risk]**. No copyleft that requires disclosure of Fernhill proprietary code without prior written approval.

### 6. Data Protection, Security and Subcontractors
6.1 Fernhill is Data Fiduciary, Orbitmade is Data Processor for sleep/heart-rate Personal Data. Orbitmade shall: process only on Fernhill documented instructions and for stated purpose; implement reasonable security safeguards u/s.8(5); restrict access; notify breach to Fernhill within **[24 hours]** with details and assist remediation/principal-rights requests.
6.2 No sub-processing/subcontracting of Services or Personal Data without Fernhill prior written consent **[list QA subcontractors/countries: [●]]**. Orbitmade remains fully liable; flow-down DPDP, IP and confidentiality terms.
6.3 No transfer outside India to a country notified as restricted u/s.16(1). On termination/expiry, return/delete Personal Data and certify, except as law requires.

### 7. Warranties
Each party: authority. Orbitmade warrants: original Deliverables (save approved Pre-Existing/Open Source); non-infringement; no encumbrance; compliance with laws including DPDP Act; Services professional and per specs; disclosed Open Source complete.

### 8. Indemnities
Orbitmade indemnifies Fernhill against third-party claims/losses from: IP infringement by Deliverables (save Fernhill-provided materials); breach of Data/Security, warranties or applicable law. Fernhill indemnifies for its materials/instructions. Indemnified party: prompt notice, control of defence to indemnifier subject to consent on settlement.

### 9. Limitation of Liability
9.1 Cap: aggregate liability capped at **100% of Fees paid/payable** **[or: paid]**, except: IP/ confidentiality breach, data breach, fraud/wilful misconduct, breach of law, indemnities, and non-payment.
9.2 No exclusion for what cannot be excluded by law. No liability for indirect/consequential loss except for above carve-outs/breach of data/IP.

### 10. Term and Termination
10.1 Term until final Acceptance and warranty **[12 months]** unless terminated. Either may terminate for material breach uncured in **[30 days]**, insolvency, or convenience **[with [30/60] days notice + payment for Accepted work]**.
10.2 On termination/expiry Fernhill gets: all paid-for and in-progress Deliverables with source code/docs; assignment/licences under Cl.5 take effect; transition assistance **[30 days]** at SOW rates; return of Confidential Information; deletion of Personal Data per Cl.6.

### 11. Non-Solicitation
Neither shall, during term + **12 months**, solicit for employment employees materially involved, save general ads and unsolicited applications. Breach remedy: injunctive relief + damages.

### 12. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
Laws of India. Arbitration under Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seat Mumbai, **[sole arbitrator]** English. Mumbai courts retain interim-relief jurisdiction.

**Further boilerplate (headings only, to be added):** Confidentiality | Notices | Entire Agreement | Assignment | Force Majeure | Severability | Waiver | Costs/Taxes | Counterparts/Execution.

## 2. Cover email to John Doe

**Subject: Draft ready — 4 calls needed before signature**

Dear John,

Draft protects Fernhill but keeps it signable. Deviations from term sheet:

1. **No endless testing / no 5-day auto-pass:** 10-day test vs. criteria + 2 cure rounds; silence = pass but warranty survives.
2. **Liability capped at 100% fees** with carve-outs (IP, data, fraud, law) — unlimited liability would kill deal; cap still covers fee refund + damages.
3. **IP: assignment, not “work-for-hire”** — contractor work needs s.19 written assignment (perpetual/worldwide). Core stays Orbitmade’s but broadly licensed to you.
4. **GPL SleepWave blocked:** would force open-sourcing app. Require permissive replacement unless you accept risk.

**Decide:** (a) milestones total ₹1.96cr vs ₹2cr; (b) SleepWave replace/approve; (c) approve QA sub-contractor countries; (d) payment terms & delay remedy.

Regards,
[Counsel]
